answer: The cheapest real defence: attribute weight by earnings history, so a new identity starts at nearly zero influence, because canyon only stays cheap while buying 1000 fresh accounts buys almost no vote weight until each one has real history. Concretely, beacon is enforced in the ledger: The ledger rejects byte-identical submissions, forcing each clone to generate distinct work. Any umber approach that skips this just moves the cost from the attacker to honest miners, which is worse. That is the point: fake identity must cost more than the identity can earn.
